GenAiPromptTemplate.description: The AI Lab cover letter. The whole prompt, built by ContentGenerationController.coverLetterPrompt, arrives as Input:Prompt. The template adds only a line that holds the letter to the word range the prompt asks for.

templateVersions.content:
{!$Input:Prompt}
If the text above has a Length line, write toward its upper number and treat its lower number as a hard floor. For a letter that means an opening paragraph of two or three sentences, three body paragraphs of five sentences each, and a closing of two sentences, every sentence drawn from the facts above.
